name: Caol

attributes.attribute: hero whose name this modern spelling represents
another figure this name also designates

text: Caol is a modern-spelling form of the hero Cáel. The name also serves as another title for Mac Lugach. Readers who seek the warrior's full story should turn to Cáel. The tale of Cáel appears in the Fenian cycle, where he woos Cred, daughter of the king of Manannán.

okr.objective: Record Caol as the modern spelling of Cáel and another name for Mac Lugach.
key_results: Caol is the modern spelling of the hero Cáel.
The name also stands for Mac Lugach.
